title: Panel Discussion: Rebranding Yourself for a New Career Path
session_title: Minority Affairs Community (MAC) & Young Professionals (YP) Panel Discussion: Rebranding Yourself for a New Career Path
abstract: This panel will discuss ways you can (re)brand yourself and your resume for your next job. This panel will feature members from the AIChE Board of Directors who have changed their career path and Young Professionals who have used many resources to broaden their job responsibilities. Tell us your goals and hear from folks who were or are on a similar journey while learning about resources that AIChE can offer you.
